Camel Unease |MRange = 0.42 tiles |LOS = 6.222 tiles }} {{Quote|Highly mobile and durable melee unit effective against all cavalry.|''Age of Empires IV'' description}} The '''Camel Rider''' is a [[Unique unit#Age of Empires IV|unique]] light [[Melee cavalry unit (Age of Empires IV)|melee cavalry unit]] available to the [[Abbasid Dynasty]] in ''[[Age of Empires IV]]''. It can be trained at the [[Stable (Age of Empires IV)|Stable]] starting in the [[Castle Age (Age of Empires IV)|Castle Age]]. It possesses an aura that reduces the damage of nearby enemy Cavalry units by 20%. The Camel Rider is also available to the [[Byzantines (Age of Empires IV)|Byzantines]] as a [[Mercenary House#Mercenary units|mercenary unit]]. == Abilities == * [[File:AoE4 CamelUnease.png|22px]] '''Camel Unease''' (passive): Enemy horse-riding cavalry within a 5-tile radius deal 20% less damage. * [[File:AoE4 CamelSupportEnhancement.png|22px]] '''Camel Support''' (passive, requires [[Camel Support|unlock]]): Allied infantry units within a 5-tile radius receive +2 melee and ranged armor. == Tactics == Camel Riders are among the strongest individual units available, although their power comes at a high cost and slow train time. Compared to the [[Lancer (Age of Empires IV)|Lancer]], a Camel Rider has more hit points, and when fully upgraded has similar melee armor and a higher speed. Despite their faster Rate of Fire, their overall base DPS is still notably less than that of a Lancer, though still above a [[Man-at-Arms (Age of Empires IV)|Man-at-Arms]]. They also do not possess a charge attack. Camel Riders also benefit from being light cavalry, meaning they do not take extra damage from [[Crossbowman (Age of Empires IV)|Crossbowmen]]. Camel Riders specialize in taking down cavalry, against whom they take less damage and deal significant bonus damage. When upgraded, their speed meets or exceeds that of every unit except the [[Yari Cavalry]] and [[Yuan Raider]]. Even though their Camel Unease ability does not apply to elephants, Camel Riders can still perform well against [[Tower Elephant]]s, but [[War Elephant (Age of Empires IV)|War Elephants]] remain a significant threat due to their bonus against cavalry. While Spearman can be considered a counter, Camel Riders have significant speed to avoid engagements, and can be paired with [[Camel Archer (Age of Empires IV)|Camel Archers]] or upgraded [[Composite Bows]] [[Archer (Age of Empires IV)|Archers]] who have an attack bonus against Spearmen. Enemy Archers can also be dangerous if massed, since while the Camel Rider does have some ranged armor when upgraded, it is not as high as that of a Lancer or Horseman. This can be compensated by pairing camel units with Horsemen or [[Mangonel (Age of Empires IV)|Mangonels]]. However, if facing lower amounts of Archers, Camel Riders on their own make a respectable counter to the common Archer/Lancer pairing. For tactics applying to all units with the Camel Unease debuff, see [[Ability (Age of Empires IV)#Camel Unease|Camel Unease]]. == Unit comparison == {| class="fandom-table" ! !{{4icons|Horseman}} !{{4icons|Camel Rider}} !{{4icons|Lancer}} |- |'''Cost''' |{{Resources|food = 100|wood = 20}} |{{Resources|food = 160|wood = 30|gold = 30}} |{{Resources|food = 140|gold = 100}} |- |'''Training Time''' |22.5 s |35 s |35 s |- |'''Attack''' |9 (Regular)

With [[update 8324]], it takes 60 seconds. * Originally, Camel Riders dealt +10 bonus torch damage vs siege. With [[patch 11009]], it was increased to +20. With [[Season Two Update 17718]], Camel Riders attack [[siege engine]]s with their melee attack which was granted +10 bonus damage vs siege. * Originally, Camel Riders had 9 attack and +18 bonus attack vs. cavalry, while Elite Camel Riders had 10 attack and +20 bonus attack vs. cavalry. With the [[Season One Update]], Camel Riders have 14 attack and +14 bonus attack vs. cavalry, while Elite Camel Riders have 16 attack and +16 bonus attack vs. cavalry. * Originally, Camel Riders cost {{Resources|food = 180|gold = 60}}. With the [[Update 7.0.5861|Season Five update]], they cost {{Resources|food = 160|gold = 30|wood = 30}}. With [[patch 11.1.1201]], they cost {{Resources|food = 130|gold = 45|wood = 45}}. * Originally, Mercenary Camel Riders received gold from the [[Expilatores]] upgrade when killing Villagers.
